name: corridor-curve-polyline-loss
description: The bowed corridor with a 4.5 km detour 400 m off its road line: after five fixes off the line the remaining distance falls back to the chord estimate, nothing ends the corridor, the car comes back to the line and Fin de tramo is spoken at the far gate.
